scripts.build:wasm: em++ -O3 --std=c++17 --bind -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_NAME=createPokerCore -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s ENVIRONMENT=web core/card.cpp core/deck.cpp core/evaluator.cpp wasm/bindings.cpp -o src/wasm/poker_core.js
